sourceText: 第二个小坑：全历史 fork 不能指定 worker 角色。我不需要它继承全历史，给它明确指令就够了，重新按 worker 角色启动。补充：应该是派子agent工作完之后，想再指派这个agent干活（可能有之前记忆），但是无法指派了。
normalizedOutcome: After a worker/subagent finishes, the operator can assign follow-up work under a worker role using explicit instructions and a fresh context, without using a full-history fork.
acceptanceClaim: A completed dispatch can be reassigned through a role-aware fresh-context command that creates a new linked dispatch, renders the requested worker role and prompt path, and avoids any full-history inheritance claim.
